observation.visible_scene: A snowy outdoor forest floor. A person in a light-gray long-sleeved top kneels behind a small fire built on a snow-dusted log, with a fallen trunk at upper left and curled pieces of birch bark at the right. The person holds a dense bundle of thin, leafless twigs over a bed of burning bark at the center, hands cupping the bundle from either side.
visible_changes: The bundle of twigs is held above the flame throughout; over the clip the hands reposition slightly and the bundle tilts and settles a little lower toward the fire.

The flame at the base grows modestly: early frames show a small orange glow within the bark, while later frames (roughly from the middle onward) show taller yellow flame tongues and a faint rising haze/smoke above the twigs.
The person's right-side hand (image right) shifts its grip and finger position on the bundle, while the left-side hand (image left) keeps a similar hold on the twigs.
Background elements (fallen log, snow, bark pieces) stay in fixed positions, indicating the camera is essentially static with only minor handheld jitter.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the fire was started and what fuel or tool produced it.
Whether the twigs are being added as fuel, held to dry, or arranged into a structure, and the outcome after the clip ends.
The person's full body, face, and any equipment outside the frame.
uncertain_details: The exact intent of the hand movements (feeding twigs vs. merely steadying the bundle) is not determinable.
Small apparent shifts in the bundle and hands could partly reflect camera jitter rather than deliberate motion.
The degree of flame growth is modest and partly occluded by the twigs, so precise brightness changes are approximate.
